Schema and SEO Testing Starter

Use this Playground site to test a CSV-based schema workflow.

  1. Download the sample CSV file from /wp-content/uploads/schema-sample.csv.
  2. Add a page URL and its schema data to the CSV.
  3. Install a schema-related plugin from this screen.
  4. Import the CSV and review any URLs reported as not found.
  5. Save the valid schema and verify it on the website.
  6. If supported by the plugin, generate PHP code to keep the schema after removing the plugin.
